agents.bed: ERB 947k (erb947k, F:/tmp/erb_blob_v09x.db, k=12, 156 misses mined, rank_match 156/156)
agents.headline: When ERB loses, the seats go to same-genre near-duplicate siblings of the gold — full-size 4000-char chunks of OTHER incident tickets / rollout PRs / email threads in the gold's own document family that scatter more distinct query keywords than gold's best chunk (top-1 winner ~10.9 vs gold-chunk ~6.8 on drowned semantic) — and there is NO hub effect: 1,645 unique winners fill 1,674 seats (repeaters hold 3.2%).

categories.name: Semantic drowned under sibling decoys (pool-absent)
categories.mechanism: Paraphrase queries carry the biggest keyword bags (mean n_kw 45.0) but strip gold's anchor terms: gold's best chunk covers only 15% of query terms (6.82/45.0) vs top-1 winner 25% (10.92); top-1 out-covers gold in 47/61. Winners are 86.9% at the 4000-char chunk cap (gold at cap 50.8%, mean 3,186 chars) — length is a coverage subsidy (kw_cov~n_chars r=0.279; at-cap winners avg 10.54 distinct terms vs 7.88 under-cap). The seats are NOT random high-DF junk: 45% of delivered docs share gold's genre (5.7x base-rate lift; majority-same-genre slate in 30/61), and the slate is more like itself than like gold (winner-winner head jaccard 0.133 vs winner-gold 0.073) — a coherent topic-sibling cluster with gold below its floor. Sharpener: in 26/61 the gold DOC would tie/beat the top winner at doc granularity (union kw_cov 11.67 >= top-1) but its best CHUNK loses — chunk-split dilution (mean gold_n 2.4, union-minus-first gap 4.9 terms).
categories.evidence: n_kw 45.0; gold_first kw_cov 6.82 vs top1 10.92 (top1>gold 47/61, tie 4); winners at cap 86.9% vs gold 50.8%; same-genre frac 0.45 = 5.7x lift; slate jaccard 0.133 vs 0.073; union>=top1 while first<top1 in 26/61; repeat-winner seats only 1.1% of 900 semantic seats

categories.name: Near-band RRF fusion losses (live_rank 13-100)
categories.mechanism: 20 semantic + 18 basic + 3 other; gold IS in the pool at median live_rank 20 (range 13-45). Coverage is NOT what beats it: gold UNION out-covers the delivered majority in 14/20 semantic (15/21 incl. the seat-capped one) — reproducing PR #428's receipt (b) — while individual top-1 winners out-cover gold_first (12.55 vs 7.75). The loss is rank aggregation: winners place in more RRF lanes (FTS+tag+synonym), and gold sits just over the lip — for the 6 misses with gold visible in map_top15, seat-12-to-gold relative score gap is 1.5%-30.3%, median 11.2%. Tightest sibling crowding of any category: same-genre frac 0.60 (6.0x lift), majority-same-genre 25/41, winner-winner jaccard 0.184. Exemplar erb_036: gold 5xx incident SUP-700707 outranked by four OTHER 5xx incident tickets.
categories.evidence: live_rank med 20, max 45; gold union out-covers majority 14/20 sem; gold visible in map_top15 for 6, gap 1.5/3.8/5.6/11.2(med)/16.8/24.7/30.3%; same-genre 0.60, lift 6.0x; winners at cap 82.7% vs gold 39.0%

categories.name: Basic scattered-term outranking (pool-absent, phrase-bearing gold)
categories.mechanism: Confirms receipt (c): gold holds the exact phrase (37/37 return on phrase probe; phrase DF 166 vs best-term DF>=3001) but never enters the live pool because unstructured term-breadth wins: top-1 winner scatters 8.92 distinct query words vs gold's 6.65 (top1>gold 24/37, tie 5), and 86.5% of winners sit at the 4000-char cap vs gold 35.1% (gold mean 3,041 chars — often short thread chunks like erb_001's 1,528-char PR comment). Winners skew to big JSON ticket bodies: ENG/PM/SUP ticket chunks take 183/612 basic seats (30%) vs gold being a ticket in only 8/60 basic misses; same-genre frac 0.41 (3.0x lift). A 4000-char P1 ticket scattering 9/28 query words outranks the short chunk containing the answer phrase.
categories.evidence: top1 kw_cov 8.92 vs gold 6.65; top1>gold 24/37; winners at cap 86.5% vs gold 35.1%; mean n_kw 27.6; same-genre 0.41/3.0x; prior probe 37/37 phrase-return

categories.name: Other-class pool-absent (aggregation-shaped queries)
categories.mechanism: completeness 3 + intra_document_reasoning 5 + conflicting_info 2 + constrained 1. Gold is the most fragmented here (mean gold_n 4.8 chunks; per-chunk coverage 27% of query terms vs 41% union) — cross-chunk questions dilute every individual gold chunk below single-chunk competitors. Winners are meta/process docs ABOUT the topic instead of instance docs: erb_436 ('which team got most postmortem action items') delivers the postmortem TEMPLATE, an action-items BOT ticket, and follow-up-tracker threads — topically dead-on, evidentially useless. union>=top1 while first<top1 in 6/11.
categories.evidence: gold_n 4.8 (highest); gold_first cov/n_kw 0.27 vs union 0.41; union>=top1-but-first<top1 6/11; same-genre frac 0.38

categories.name: Seat-capped (live_rank 7-12, class cap delivered 6)
categories.mechanism: The ONLY delivery-side loss channel on this bed. Gold made the pool top-12 (live_rank 7,7,9,9,11,11) but the class cap shipped 6 seats; k=12 delivery recovers all 6 by definition. 5 basic + 1 semantic (erb_045/046/049/053/144/187). All 6 slates are majority same-genre siblings (frac 0.83 — e.g. erb_045: Medicore email thread gold beaten by four OTHER Medicore/procurement email threads). Delivery machinery is otherwise exonerated: across all 156 misses, delivered = map_top prefix as a SET (0 skipped pool docs, 0 docs pulled from beyond map_top15, 0 gold pass-overs by freshness gate or elision); the eps-band combinator only REORDERS within the delivered set (120/156 slates permuted).
categories.evidence: 6/156 = 3.8%; delivered_count=6 on 33 misses total but only these 6 have live_rank<=12; ranks 7,7,9,9,11,11; same-genre 0.83; 0/156 gold pass-overs; 120/156 slates reordered vs map order, 0 skips

agents.surprises: Four things cut against going-in assumptions. (1) The hub-doc hypothesis is dead on this bed: 1,645 unique winners fill 1,674 seats; docs winning >=2 misses hold 3.2% of seats and the top repeater wins only 6 — there is no generic-vocabulary monopolist at 947k; the interloper population is a diffuse long tail of one-off topical siblings, so no blocklist/downweight of specific genes can help. (2) The delivery machinery is fully exonerated: in all 156 misses the delivered set equals the map_top prefix set (0 skips, 0 pulls from beyond rank 15, 0 gold pass-overs by freshness gate or session elision); the eps-band combinator reorders 120/156 slates but never changes membership — the only delivery-side loss is the 6-seat class cap (6 misses, 3.8%). (3) Length is a quiet subsidy: 85% of winning seats are 4000-char cap chunks vs 43% of golds (gold mean 3,043 chars), and at-cap chunks average 10.5 distinct query terms vs 7.9 under-cap — distinct-term kw_cov, as used by the lanes, structurally favors the longest chunk in a sibling family. (4) Chunk-split dilution is a first-class mechanism, not a footnote: in 65/156 misses (41.7%) the gold DOCUMENT's union coverage ties or beats the top winner while its best single chunk loses — doc-level (or fielded/grouped) coverage aggregation would flip the duel in over 40% of misses, which converges with the cc-exchange 0017 chunk-granularity finding and suggests the highest-leverage fix is aggregating lane evidence per source doc before RRF seating rather than any per-chunk score change.
agents.class_notes: semantic (82 misses): 61 drowned pool-absent + 20 near-band + 1 seat-capped; longest keyword bags (n_kw 45.8) make coverage a diffuse bag-of-generic-terms contest that max-length siblings win; prior receipts (a)/(b) both reproduced — near-band gold union out-covers the delivered majority in 14/20, so banded coverage stays a dead discriminator (PR #428 stands). basic (60): 37 pool-absent are OUTRANKED not unreachable (receipt (c) confirmed) — phrase-bearing golds are short chunks (35% at cap, mean 3,041 chars) beaten by 4000-char ticket JSON scattering ~2.3 more distinct terms; plus 18 near-band and 5 of the 6 seat-cap losses — basic is the class the 6-seat floor actually taxes. intra_document_reasoning (6), completeness (3), conflicting_info (2), constrained (1): aggregation-shaped queries with the most fragmented golds (gold_n up to 9); winners are process/template docs about the topic rather than instance docs — a distinct failure flavor where topical relevance is high but evidential value is zero. miscellaneous (2): both near-band, nothing distinctive. constrained (1): n_kw=66 query, gold chunk covers 4/66 — pure keyword-bag dilution.

agents.bed: EnronQA-padded — 829k genes (85k Enron emails + ~744k ERB engineering padding), same 500 queries as native; 104 misses (.792) vs native 72 (.856); rank_match 104/104
agents.headline: Padding takes ZERO of the 1122 delivered seats — when gold loses, other Enron emails win (thread siblings, correspondent mail, mailbox copies), and the .856→.792 decay is gold being crowded out of the fixed-depth candidate pool (pool-absent 22→49) plus small internal rank slides that drop it from top-12 to 13-30.

categories.name: Pool-absent candidate crowd-out
categories.mechanism: Gold never enters the fused score map at all (live_rank None, and not shadowed by a delivered copy). These golds are lexically weak: mean gold_kw_cov 4.51 of 17.9 kw (cov ratio 0.249) vs 7.71 of 22.6 (0.335) for pool-present misses; 28/42 are rephrased-class (paraphrase stripped the anchor phrase). This is where the padding actually bites: with the only change being +744k ERB docs, pool-absent jumped 22 (native) → 49 (padded) and 15 shared needles went present→absent — padding consumes candidate-fetch depth (fts5_candidate_depth = max_genes*4) and shifts term-frequency mass, evicting low-coverage golds from candidacy, yet never scores high enough to reach the fused head itself (map_top is 100% Enron). The seats gold vacates go to higher-coverage Enron mail: in 32/49 absent misses the top winner's kw_cov exceeds gold's union coverage (e.g. 'AGT Critical System Warning' ops mail, cov 8, beats the Amazon order email, cov 5, on generic query terms customer/action/order/email).
categories.evidence: absent n=49 total, 42 without a delivered near-copy; gold_kw_cov 4.51 vs 7.71 (present); cov ratio 0.249 vs 0.335; rephrased 28/42; native→padded absent 22→49; shared present→absent = 15; top-winner-cov>gold in 32/49

categories.name: Correspondent / thread-sibling outrank
categories.mechanism: Gold is in the pool at 13-100 but the seats go to mail from the SAME correspondent pair — reply legs, other threads between the same two people, or other mail from the query-named sender. The query's strongest tokens are person names, and every email that person touched matches them equally; gold's distinguishing content words are diluted. Across all 104 misses, 471/1122 seats (42.0%) share an email address with gold's header, and in 50/104 misses at least half the winners do. Short reply legs win despite LOWER coverage: enron_001_r's rank-1 winner is John Arnold's 561-char reply with kw_cov 4, score 0.3513, while gold (Gapinski's 2713-char original, kw_cov 7) sits at rank 35 score 0.1256 — the reply's subject/tag-tier rank feeds RRF harder than gold's body-term coverage. Not hub docs: only 8 genes win across ≥2 distinct questions (max 2), so these are per-query thread neighborhoods, not global magnets.
categories.evidence: 24 misses (16 new); seats sharing an email addr with gold: 471/1122 = 42.0%; ≥half-winners-share in 50/104 misses; genes recurring across distinct questions: 8, all x2; 15/24 rephrased

categories.name: Near-duplicate copy shadowing
categories.mechanism: A near-copy of gold itself wins the seat (best delivered-head Jaccard vs gold head ≥ 0.5) — the same newsletter or thread email ingested from a different mailbox/folder. The copy has equal-or-higher kw_cov (chunk boundaries differ slightly), so gold's own content outranks gold: enron_017_o's gold is the Williams Energy News Live newscast in crandell-s/deleted_items (cov 8, pool-absent) while the identical newscast in zipper-a wins rank 1 with cov 9 and two more copies (mckay-b, carson-m) take ranks 2-3. In enron_041_r two byte-identical Matt Wilson elk-hunt copies hold ranks 1-2 (scores .3825/.3651) above gold at 16. From the answer's standpoint many of these are benign (content delivered), but the receipt scores them as misses. 7 of the 49 pool-absent misses also had a J≥0.5 copy delivered and are counted here.
categories.evidence: best-dup Jaccard ≥0.5 in 17/104 misses (16 after trim takes precedence, 7 of them new); ≥0.8 in 5; among pool-absent, 7 had a near-copy delivered; exemplars show identical Subject+Sender, different File: mailbox paths

categories.name: Delivery-side trim / abstain
categories.mechanism: Gold IS in the pool top-12 but delivery shipped fewer seats: 7 misses got 6-seat deliveries with gold at pool rank 7-10 (enron_025_r lr10, 036_o lr8, 100_o lr9, 100_r lr8, 125_r lr7, 193_r lr10, 242_o lr7), and enron_173_r shipped ZERO docs with gold at pool rank 2 (score 0.372 vs head 0.383 — an abstain/empty delivery, the single most avoidable miss in the dump). The 6-seat rate is not padding-driven: 19/104 padded deliveries were 6-seat vs 21/72 native. 7 of these 8 are NEW misses — on native the same golds ranked ≤6 and made the narrow delivery; the padded bed's small rank pressure (one to four positions) pushed them into the trimmed 7-12 band.
categories.evidence: 8 misses (7 new): 7 with ndel=6 and lr 7-10, 1 with ndel=0 and lr=2; delivered-width distribution 12-seat:84, 6-seat:19, 0-seat:1; native 6-seat:21/72

categories.name: Near-band rank slide, mixed winners
categories.mechanism: Gold sits just below band (lr 13-32 in 7/8) with no dominant winner signature: winners are a grab-bag of Enron mail with kw_cov within ±2 of gold, no correspondent overlap majority, no copy, top winner cov ≤ gold cov. This is pure fused-rank churn from the corpus change: e.g. enron_026_o (Shell Houston Open, gold cov 9 at lr 14) loses to perfmgmt and GCP counterparty mail at cov 8-10. Consistent with the paired shift measurement: for shared misses present in both pools, 15/19 got worse (median live_rank 16→18) and only 2 improved — the same reshuffle that also RECOVERED 16 native misses into padded hits (churn is bidirectional; net −32).
categories.evidence: 8 misses (4 new), 6/8 original-class; shared both-present pairs: worse 15 / better 2 / same 2, median 16→18; recovered needles = 16

categories.name: Coverage outgun by unrelated mail
categories.mechanism: Gold in pool 13-100 but strangers (no correspondent link, no copy) simply match more extracted keywords: top winner kw_cov > gold union cov, on generic vocabulary shared across a genre — enron_018_o's casino-odds promo (gold cov 3, lr 32) loses to other casino spam at cov 4-5 ('Win up to $1,000,000', 'FREE X-MAS CASINO CHIPS'). Genre-mates outgun a lexically thin gold. Bed-wide the coverage duel favors winners: top winner cov > gold in 45/103, == in 29, < in 29; in 50/103 misses ALL delivered docs have cov ≥ gold; mean 5.26 of 12 winners strictly beat gold's coverage. Winners are also longer (median 2279 chars vs gold 1708) — more text, more keyword hits.
categories.evidence: 6 misses (3 new); duel: >45/==29/<29 of 103 with non-empty delivery; all-12-≥-gold in 50; mean strict-beaters 5.26; winner chars med 2279 vs gold 1708

agents.surprises: 1) Zero padding seats ANYWHERE despite padding being ~90% of the corpus — not one of 1122 delivered seats or 1560 map_top entries is an ERB engineering doc (verified three ways: header/folder-tag classifier with the native bed as false-positive control at the same 3-doc residue rate, an engineering-marker regex with only 4 false positives, and eyeballing all 30 unclassified heads). The distractor mass loses every fused-head duel to Enron mail, yet still costs 6.4pp of recall purely at the candidate-fetch/pool tier. 2) The task brief predicted 32 new misses; the truth is 48 new + 16 RECOVERED = net 32 — a quarter of the native misses were healed by the same reshuffle that created the new ones, so the padding effect is bidirectional rank churn with a negative mean, not one-way suppression. 3) enron_173_r shipped an empty delivery with gold at pool rank 2, score gap 0.011 — an abstain-gate miss, not a retrieval miss. 4) No mega-hub interlopers on this bed: the strongest recurring winner appears in only 2 distinct questions (native-style correspondent 'hubs' operate per-query as thread neighborhoods here, holding 42% of seats via header identity rather than via a few globally magnetic docs).
agents.class_notes: Rephrased-class misses dominate: 62/104 (59.6%) overall and 30/48 of the new misses. Rephrased is over-represented exactly where lexical anchors matter: 28/42 of pool-absent-crowd-out misses (66.7%) and its absent-gold cov ratio (0.249) shows the paraphrase stripped the anchor phrase that FTS needs — anchor loss makes gold fragile, and the padded bed's tighter candidate competition converts fragile into absent (the native bed tolerated more of these at ranks 13-30). Original-class misses skew toward pure rank churn: 6/8 of the rank_slide_other category is original-class, gold cov ≈ winners' cov, just below band. n_kw runs 21.0 (original) vs 19.9 (rephrased); gold union coverage 6.9 vs 5.7 — rephrased queries are both slightly shorter and markedly worse-covered by their golds.

agents.bed: MULocBench (muloc) — issue→file localization, 45 repos, 108,375 genes, 680 file_loc needles, 375 mined misses
agents.headline: When gold loses on muloc, the winner is overwhelmingly the repo's own process boilerplate (GitHub issue templates, CONTRIBUTING, README, troubleshooting docs) or a vocabulary-aggregating sibling code file (sysinfo/collect_env/entry-point modules): the queries are filled-in issue templates, so the template file itself out-covers the gold source file ~5x on extracted keywords (winner median kw_cov 14-21 vs gold-chunk median 4-5 on ~124-keyword queries), while gold's coverage is diluted across a median 7 chunks.

categories.name: Meta/process-boilerplate capture (issue templates, CONTRIBUTING, README, troubleshooting)
categories.mechanism: MULocBench queries are filled GitHub issue forms; the repo's own .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml (95 rank-1 wins) and CONTRIBUTING/README/troubleshooting docs (54 more incl. post-precedence overlap) contain the exact boilerplate half of the query verbatim ('I have searched the existing issues', checklists, 'provide a description that is worded well'). On n_kw med=166 queries the template covers med=21.5 distinct keywords vs gold_first chunk 5.0 — winner out-covers gold_first in 137/140. FTS+RRF has no way to discount form boilerplate, and the informative tokens (site name, function name) are a handful of terms drowned by dozens of template hits. 76/140 same-repo (own template beats own extractor), 64 cross-repo (another repo's template bleeds in). Buckets: 91 pool-absent, 49 near-band.
categories.evidence: rank-1 true path types (all 372 resolved via corpus substring match): meta_template=95, meta_docs=54. yt-dlp+ytdl gold misses (43): 97% of their 510 delivered seats (495) are template/CONTRIBUTING/README chunks; yt-dlp's 4 template .yml files are each ingested twice (ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ + ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/), the 8 gene copies appear in 41-44 misses each. 30/35 yt-dlp misses have a yt-dlp ISSUE_TEMPLATE at rank-1.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M1 — Query-vocabulary echo beats answer-vocabulary gold (anchor loss): the winner is whatever document speaks the QUESTION's words — question-echo turns, filled-template boilerplate, third-person observations, formula/analytic prose, paraphrase-stripped topic siblings — while gold states the answer in different words and under-covers the extracted keyword bag. The dominant pool-absent driver on every bed.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: locomo: 912/1344 pool-absent; gold covers 15% of query kws (1.48/11.9); a question-echo turn with kw_cov>=gold sits in top-6 in 68% of weak-anchor misses (369/542); cognitive zero-anchor 370 (335 cov0), winner-to-gold-cue Jaccard 0.010 < 0.015 random-cue baseline. locomo_obs: 399 cue orphans (335 cov0, 397/399 pool-absent) + 357 crowd-outs where the obs restates the scene in the question's third-person vocabulary (rank1-vs-gold_first duel 285W/67T/5L). enron_v2: outgun 21/72, max-interloper coverage duel 21W/0T/0L, 13/21 pool-absent, rephrased-only misses skew here 9/24. enron_padded: pool-absent crowd-out 42/104, absent-gold cov 4.51 vs 7.71 for pool-present, 28/42 rephrased. erb947k: semantic drowned 61/156 — gold-first covers 15% of terms (6.82/45.0) vs top-1 winner 25% (10.92), top1>gold 47/61; plus the meta-vs-instance flavor (erb other-class 11: postmortem TEMPLATE beats postmortems; financebench wrong_doctype 9: 10-K prose DEFINING EBITDAR beats the earnings table CONTAINING it). financebench: 118/127 pool-absent, gold covers 18.6% of kws vs winner 26.8%, comp-plan/proxy prose is a near-perfect lexical mimic of metric-formula boilerplate ('round' 28/50, 'decimal' 28/50 of metrics queries). muloc: meta/boilerplate capture 140/375 — the query IS the filled issue template, so the template file covers med 21.5 kws vs gold-chunk 5.0 (winner>gold_first 137/140).
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: Largest population, weakest direct lever. Bed category counts (disjoint within bed): locomo 912, locomo_obs ~610 (399 orphans + majority of 357 crowd-outs), enron_v2 21, enron_padded 42, erb947k ~72 (61 drowned + 11 other-class), financebench ~118, muloc 140 (template-echo variant). Basis: per-bed taxonomy category partitions. Only sub-slices are recoverable via ladder legs (identity/KV/phrase peel off the misses where the query carries an unused anchor); the zero-anchor core — locomo cognitive 335 cov0 + locomo_obs 335 cov0 (same needles, two beds) — is unrecoverable by ANY lexical lever by construction.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M3 — Identity-anchor asymmetry: identity signals (person, company, year, repo, speaker) either fail to match (alias/multiword/concatenated tag tokens, extraction death) or fire on the WRONG documents (addressee-tagged turns, the named person's other mail, the named external project's own README) — so the tag/name lane rewards proximity to the entity instead of possession of the answer.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: financebench: 109/127 misses have wrong_company (68) or wrong_year (41) delivered majorities; identity tags are present and correct on every gold (mean 8) yet buy nothing — 13 alias-named (JPM/MGM/J&J) + 15 multiword ('bestbuy','cocacola' unmatchable by any query token) + '3M' apparently dies in keyword extraction (0/12 3M docs delivered on all 8 3M misses); year never constrains (older winners 254:65 despite year stated in 36/41 queries). muloc: 167/372 rank-1 winners are cross-repo; entity trap muloc_0121 (ChatGLM-6B's own README ranks 1-3 over the repo where support must be added); docs-capture category only 33% same-repo. locomo: addressee-tag inversion — gold is spoken BY the queried person in 80% of name-bearing misses but carries no self-name tag, while 'Wow, Caroline!' turns are name-tagged: w1-tagged-gold-not in 631 misses; near-band tag duel w1 0.89 vs gold 0.17, gold ahead 0/311. locomo_obs: 73% (33/45) of wrong-conversation rank-1 obs are same-first-name speaker collisions. enron_v2: correspondent/person hub 25/72 — the person-hub 6 LOSE the coverage duel (0W/1T/5L) yet win on name-list rank. enron_padded: 24/104; 42% of all delivered seats share an email address with gold's header. erb947k: exemplar-level only (erb_183 wrong-customer 'deep dive' title decoy).
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: financebench: bounded above by 109/127 (identity-majority misses) — but the same-filing category (9 misses, gold kw_cov 1-5) shows in-filing gold can still lose, so identity confinement alone does not close the bed. muloc: bounded by 167 cross-repo rank-1 misses (basis: path-verified winners); same-repo capture (205) needs other levers. locomo: a speaker-attribution field attacks the 207/311 near-band misses decided by the tag lane plus 95/121 seat-cap misses where the winner carries the name tag — the taxonomy's own claim is ~70% of conv-gold misses touched at mechanism level. enron beds: 25+24 category misses. All are mechanism-touched upper bounds, not guaranteed flips.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M4 — Chunk-split / fragmentation dilution: the gold DOCUMENT's union keyword coverage ties or beats the top winner, but every individual gold chunk sits below single-chunk competitors — per-chunk scoring taxes fragmented golds on multi-fact and long-doc beds.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: erb947k: 65/156 (41.7%) have gold_union >= top1 while gold_first < top1 (26 semantic drowned + 22 near-band + 9 basic + 6 other + 2 seat-capped); mean union-minus-first gap ~5 terms; gold_n up to 9 on aggregation queries. muloc: gold union med 13 vs gold_first med 4 on n_kw med 124 (gold spread over med 7 / mean 16 chunks); rank-1 winner beats gold_union in only 176/372 vs beats gold_first in 354/372 — i.e. gold union ties-or-beats the winner in 196/372. enron_v2: 8/72 golds are headerless later chunks whose Subject/Sender anchors live in a sibling gene (feeds the hub category). financebench variant: same-filing wrong-page 9/127 — right filing, prose neighbors beat the statement page. locomo: multihop pool-absence (85/161) — each gold turn holds one hop of a multi-fact query.
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: Duel-flip basis (necessary, not sufficient, for a rank flip): erb947k 65/156; muloc up to 196/372 union-ties-or-beats. Doc-level (or fielded/grouped) lane-evidence aggregation before RRF seating would flip the coverage duel in >40% of erb misses — the erb taxonomy names it the single highest-leverage fix, converging with the cc-exchange 0017 chunk-granularity finding. Do NOT sum with M1/M3: these rows overlap those categories within each bed (the erb 65 spans four of its five categories).

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M5 — Length/shape subsidy (direction FLIPS by bed): the scoring pipeline's length handling systematically favors the interloper's document shape over gold's. On document beds, distinct-term kw_cov subsidizes max-length chunks; on conversation beds, bm25 normalization plus tag count subsidizes short dense turns/obs. The invariant is that gold's shape loses, not that any one shape wins.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: Long-wins family — erb947k: 85.0% of winner seats (1423/1674) are 4000-char-cap chunks vs 42.9% of golds; at-cap winners average 10.54 distinct query terms vs 7.88 under-cap; kw_cov~n_chars r=0.279. financebench: winner mean 3436 chars vs gold 2144; gold digit_frac 0.104 vs winner 0.043 (number-dense statement pages have no room for query words — fin-statement pages are 72/127 golds but only 20/1440 winner seats). enron_padded: winner med 2279 vs gold 1708. enron_v2: 1899 vs 1634. muloc: 3546 vs 3303 (mild). Short-wins family — locomo: w1 median 177-192 chars vs gold 244-271 across near-band and seat-cap buckets; w1 kw-density 1.20 vs 0.97/100ch. locomo_obs: obs median 134 chars vs gold turn 232.5, 2.0x keyword density (1.63 vs 0.82), 6.9 vs 4.6 tags; winner shorter than gold in 554/745 non-cognitive misses.
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: Not separable — this is a cross-cutting modifier of M1/M4/M6 misses, not a partition (erb's 85%-at-cap stat spans all its categories). No count claimed. The flip in direction is itself the finding: any single global length-normalization change helps one bed family and hurts the other, so shape must be addressed per-lane (doc-level aggregation neutralizes the long-chunk subsidy; a fielded evidence index neutralizes the short-obs subsidy) rather than by retuning bm25.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M6 — Near-band losses are RRF lane-placement losses, not coverage losses: when gold is in the pool at rank 13-100, it frequently ties or WINS the keyword-coverage duel yet loses on fused rank because winners place in more lanes (tag/name/synonym) or higher per-lane ranks. Coverage-based diagnoses and coverage tie-breaks are dead in this band.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: enron_v2: rank-1 interloper LOSES the coverage duel in 39/72 misses while outscoring gold a median 2.33x. locomo near-band: gold cov >= w1 in 259/311; gold ahead on tags 0/311. locomo_obs near-band: union-coverage duel favors gold 145 vs 47, median RRF margin to the rank-12 seat only 0.091. erb947k near-band: gold union out-covers the delivered majority in 14/20 semantic — reproducing PR #428 receipt (b); for the 6 with gold visible in map_top15, seat-12-to-gold gap median 11.2% (min 1.5%). muloc: muloc_0201 gold covers 27 kws vs winner 19 yet ranks 7, then the trim removes it. enron_padded: top winner cov < gold in 29/103 and == in 29 among pool-present misses.
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: Near-band populations (bucket basis, overlapping M1/M3 categories): enron_v2 40, locomo 311, locomo_obs 309, erb947k 41, muloc 109, enron_padded 47, financebench 9 — ~866 cross-bed misses sit in the band where a NEW independent lane (phrase, identity field, KV) can act, since re-weighting existing coverage evidence demonstrably cannot (W2.2 kill confirmed by these duels). No recovery count claimed for the mechanism itself — it is the constraint that selects which levers can work.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M7 — Near-duplicate / copy seat burn: duplicate ingests and near-copies of the same text either win the seat instead of the graded gene (answer often delivered under the wrong id) or burn multiple seats per slice on repeated content.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: muloc: 22% of ALL delivered seats (814/3705) repeat a file already seated in the same slice (262/375 slices affected; yt-dlp misses 37% — its 4 template ymls are each ingested twice via ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ + ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/, plus OpenHands fr/zh i18n copies each ranking independently). enron_v2: 16/72 — 9 exact broadcast copies (Williams newscast: gold pool-absent while identical copies take ranks 1-3), 3 RE/FW siblings, 4 quoting emails. enron_padded: 16/104 with best-dup Jaccard >=0.5 (5 at >=0.8); 7 pool-absent golds had a near-copy delivered. erb947k explicitly does NOT show this (1645 unique winners / 1674 seats).

Flag: these misses are already counted inside M1/M3 bed partitions where categories overlap; the 16/16/muloc-seat numbers are the mechanism-specific basis.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M8 — Candidate-pool depth crowd-out: corpus mass that never wins a seat still evicts gold from the fixed-depth candidate fetch (fts5_candidate_depth = max_genes*4). Pool-tier damage is invisible to any seat-share analysis.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: enron_padded is the controlled experiment: +744k ERB padding takes ZERO of 1122 delivered seats and ZERO of 1560 map_top entries (verified 3 ways), yet pool-absent jumps 22 -> 49, 15 shared needles flip present->absent, and recall drops .856 -> .792 (net -32 needles: 48 new misses, 16 recovered — bidirectional churn, negative mean). locomo_obs: crowd-out 357/1144 where gold HAS lexical hooks (gold_first cov>=1 in 325/357) but shorter denser obs fill the depth-capped fetch first. financebench: older filings win partly on sheer candidate-page volume (5-8 older filings x ~100+ pages per company).
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: enron_padded: the 15 present->absent shared needles are the clean depth-casualty basis; the other 27 absent-crowd-out misses are coverage-outranked (top winner out-covers gold's union in 32/49) and deeper fetch alone would not seat them. locomo_obs: up to 357 mechanism-touched, but seating them still requires surviving the obs rank duel. A depth raise is a cheap probe (knob exists, #205) but is NOT a fix for out-covered golds.

cross_bed_mechanisms.mechanism: M9 — Hub-doc concentration (bed-LOCAL, not universal): a small set of globally magnetic documents takes rank-1 repeatedly on template/phatic beds — and is provably absent on the large document beds, so hub-targeted levers do not generalize.
cross_bed_mechanisms.evidence: Hubby: muloc — 96 genes appearing in >=5 misses hold 34% of all delivered slots (1244/3705); yt-dlp template files appear in 41-44 misses EACH; OpenHands local-llms.md rank-1 in 15 misses. locomo — 20 phatic addressee-praise docs take rank-1 on 18% of 1344 misses (top: 'Wow, Jolene!' x24) — the entity-hub story (#412) reappearing at turn level. financebench — moderate: top repeaters 7x (WALMART_2016_10K p60 comp-plan), Walmart 57 winner slots. NOT hubby: erb947k — 1645 unique winners fill 1674 seats, repeaters hold 3.2%, top repeater wins 6; enron_padded — max 2 distinct questions per winner gene, >=3x genes hold 1.1% of seats; enron_v2 — correspondent 'hubs' are per-query thread neighborhoods, not global magnets.
cross_bed_mechanisms.estimated_recoverable_needles: No blocklist/downweight of specific genes can help erb947k or the enron beds (taxonomy states this outright). On muloc, hub suppression is largely the same lever as M1's boilerplate stripping + M7's dedup (the hubs ARE templates and their duplicate copies) — do not double-count. No independent recovery estimate claimed.

lever_map.lever: min_delivered_docs=12 floor ([budget], shipped knob, default 0; W2.4 arm; 947k 12-vs-6 A/B in flight)
lever_map.expected_effect: +251 misses cross-bed by definition (locomo 121 / obs 79 / muloc 27 / enron_v2 10 / enron_padded 8 / erb 6), i.e. +1.3 to +5.1pp per bed — the deltas already visible as delivered-vs-final_r@12 gaps in crossbed_stats. Zero effect on financebench. Caveat: on muloc the trim is enforced by a tier-level gate (fused 15% check reproduces 0/135), so the floor must actually override that gate or muloc's 27 stay lost.

Same misses as the floor lever on muloc — these two levers overlap 100% on that bed; run them as one experiment, not two. The muloc receipts pin the firing point to tier scores upstream of RRF (steep-decay signature map[6]/map[0] 0.416 vs 0.618), which tells you which code path the ladder leg must touch.

lever_map.mechanism: M1 (basic-class variant: phrase-bearing short gold outranked by scattered-term long siblings)
lever_map.lever: phrase/proximity leg — separate detail=full evidence FTS index with exact-phrase + NEAR()
lever_map.expected_effect: Up to +37 on erb basic (37/37 return on phrase probe; phrase DF 166 vs best-term DF>=3001 — ~90x selectivity is receipt-backed) plus a share of erb's 18 near-band basic; also neutralizes M5's long-chunk subsidy for phrase-bearing golds. Scope limit the ladder must state: paraphrase-class misses get NOTHING (the query no longer contains the phrase) — this leg is for basic/original-form queries only.

lever_map.lever: title/doc-identity leg — filenames, doc/company names, years, doctypes as first-class matchable fields, WITH alias/multiword normalization
lever_map.expected_effect: financebench is the gate: bounded above by 109/127 identity-majority misses, but the leg no-ops on ~28/68 wrong-company misses unless it ships alias handling (13 abbrev + 15 multiword tag-unmatchable name forms, and '3M' dying in keyword extraction is a Stage-1 bug the field index can't see past). muloc: attacks up to 167 cross-repo rank-1 misses via repo-identity confinement. erb: kills the erb_183-style wrong-customer title decoy. Residual floor: financebench same-filing (9 misses) proves gold can still lose INSIDE the right doc — identity confinement composes with the KV leg, it doesn't replace it.

lever_map.mechanism: M3 (speaker variant: addressee-tag inversion on conversational beds)
lever_map.lever: speaker-attribution tag/field at ingest (tag the SPEAKER of a turn, not just addressee mentions) — natural extension of the identity leg
lever_map.expected_effect: locomo: mechanism-touches ~70% of conv-gold misses (631 w1-name-tagged-gold-not; near-band tag duel gold ahead 0/311 — the asymmetry is total, so even parity is a large swing); biggest beneficiaries singlehop + temporal ('When did X...' queries are name + 1-2 content words). Cheap: an ingest-tagger rule, re-ingest required (tagger_version bump — pre-change beds not comparable, per v2 precedent).

lever_map.mechanism: M1 (number-dense gold: query's analytic/metric vocabulary absent from statement/table pages)
lever_map.lever: claims/KV column — value-index the key_values already extracted at ingest
lever_map.expected_effect: financebench metrics is the gate: 0/50 delivered, gold is a fin-statement page in 45/50 covering 16.9% of a 41.8-kw bag — no lexical lane can ever rank these; a value/claims lane is the only path. Also the EnronQA KV gate. Must land ON TOP of the identity leg: KV matches without company+year confinement would just add another lane the wrong filing can win.

lever_map.lever: doc-level lane-evidence aggregation before RRF seating (group per-chunk lane evidence by source doc, seat the doc, then pick its best chunk)
lever_map.expected_effect: Flips the coverage duel in 65/156 erb misses (41.7%) and up to 196/372 on muloc (gold union ties-or-beats rank-1 winner) — duel-flip is necessary-not-sufficient, so expect a fraction of that. The erb taxonomy names it the highest-leverage single fix on the 947k bed; converges with cc-exchange 0017's chunk-granularity finding. NOT on the current ladder — this is the biggest uncovered lever.

lever_map.lever: delivery-time near-duplicate suppression (drop chunks with high head-Jaccard to an already-seated doc; count dup ingest paths once)
lever_map.expected_effect: muloc: frees 1-4 seats/slice (814/3705 repeat seats; 37% on yt-dlp) — pure seat-efficiency, compounds with the 12-floor. enron beds: converts copy-shadowing misses into either hits or honest grading (union-gold over copies) — 16+16 category misses, several arguably scoring false negatives today. Cheap and receipt-friendly; zero effect on erb947k (no dups there).

lever_map.lever: query-side boilerplate stripping at Stage-1 extract (drop filled-template/checklist boilerplate from the keyword bag; per-class, classifier already identifies the query family)
lever_map.expected_effect: muloc: attacks the 140-miss meta-capture category at its root — the informative tokens (site name, function name, traceback symbols) are 2-5 terms drowned by dozens of boilerplate hits; stripping the boilerplate raises their relative weight in every lane at once. financebench metrics: same move for 'round/decimal/answer in/defined as' formula boilerplate (28/50 queries each). Risk: needs a curated boilerplate lexicon per bed family; keep it classifier-gated to avoid harming clean queries.

lever_map.lever: W2.1 COVER graph walk (query-time walk over gene_relations, rescue lane)
lever_map.expected_effect: Killed by receipt (PR #408): walk mass goes to hubs, not gold. The taxonomies retroactively explain the kill from both sides: on muloc/locomo the graph would amplify the exact hub docs that already win (M9), and on erb947k there are NO recurring winners to route around (1645/1674 unique) — the interloper population is a diffuse long tail, so a walk has no structure to exploit. No surviving variant; the surviving near-band levers are new independent LANES (phrase/identity/KV), not graph traversal.

Killed on band geometry — and the cross-bed duels confirm the kill was right at mechanism level: in the near band gold already ties or WINS coverage (locomo 259/311, obs union 145v47, enron_v2 39/72, erb 14/20 reproducing PR #428(b)) and loses anyway. Coverage is a spent signal in-band. What distinguishes the surviving versions (phrase, identity fields, KV): they inject NEW rank evidence into RRF as additional lanes rather than re-weighting the coverage evidence that already failed to discriminate.

lever_map.mechanism: M1 anchor loss (expansion as a bridge)
lever_map.expected_effect: Killed previously; the taxonomies show it would have been anti-productive: expansion grows the query-surface vocabulary, and query-surface vocabulary is what the WINNERS already speak (question-echo in top-6 68% on locomo, template echo on muloc, third-person obs vocabulary on locomo_obs). Surviving version: curated [synonyms] entries plus the identity/KV legs, which bridge to ANSWER-side vocabulary instead of amplifying question-side vocabulary.

Known constraint, now receipt-hardened: wrong-year winners skew OLDER 254:65 and the gate runs at assembly, but gold is pool-absent in 118/127 before assembly begins — the gate literally never sees the fight. Surviving version: year as a first-class identity FIELD (leg 3), which acts at retrieval where the loss actually happens.

lever_map.mechanism: M1 zero-anchor paraphrase core (locomo cognitive family)
lever_map.lever: LSA plateau checkpoint (ladder leg 6) / condition-gated dense fallback on cov~0 queries
lever_map.expected_effect: The checkpoint is an acknowledgment, not a lever — 335 cov0 needles (locomo cognitive; same needles again on the obs bed) cannot be reached lexically, full stop, and retrieval is measurably ANTI-correlated with gold there (winner-cue J 0.010 < 0.015 random baseline). A dense lane fired ONLY when Stage-1 extraction yields ~zero anchors is distinguishable from the killed default-ON dense: the 2026-08-14 isolation receipts measured dense DISPLACING gold that held lexical rank (-0.20..-0.33); cov0 queries have no lexical gold rank to displace, so the kill's mechanism does not apply. Still receipt-gated: run it as its own arm before believing it.

Cheap probe on enron_padded: the 15 present->absent needles are the clean casualty list a deeper fetch could re-admit (+3pp ceiling on that bed). Will NOT recover the 32/49 absent golds that are out-covered even at union level — depth re-admits candidates, it does not re-rank them. Latency cost scales with depth; measure before defaulting.

lever_map.mechanism: M2 (abstain flavor: empty delivery with gold in pool)
lever_map.expected_effect: One documented miss (enron_173_r: 0 docs shipped, gold at pool rank 2, 0.011 behind head) — the single cheapest recoverable miss in any dump. Tiny count, but it is a gate-calibration smell worth one look since the abstain floors were additive-calibrated and run ratio-only under RRF.

muloc: 3 all-Chinese queries extract n_kw=0, delivery abstains entirely (n_del=0) while non-lexical tiers still score a map. 3 needles, but it is a hard functional gap (any CJK corpus gets 0% from the lexical path), not a ranking nuance.

lever_map.lever: abstraction->source linkage (obs docs carry a pointer to their source turn; seating an obs credits/co-delivers the turn)
lever_map.expected_effect: Known open item from the research synthesis ('obs-enrichment displaces rather than bridges'). The obs-bed receipts quantify the prize: rank-1 winners are same-conversation obs in 92%+ of non-cognitive misses and 42-47 near-band + 42 crowd-out rank-1 obs are from gold's OWN SESSION (shadowing their own turn) — linkage converts shadowing from a loss into a hit at zero ranking change. Also partially a union-gold grading question (conv-44_q049's winning obs literally answers the question).

agents.headline: Across all seven beds, what wins when Cymatix is wrong is almost never random junk — it is a same-family sibling that speaks the QUERY's vocabulary while gold speaks the ANSWER's: question-echo turns, filled-template boilerplate, third-person observations, comp-plan/definitional prose, and max-length topic siblings. Two structural taxes compound this everywhere: a 6-seat delivery trim that discards gold at pool ranks 7-12 (251 misses across six beds, recoverable by definition at true k=12 — the cleanest receipt-ready win, directly feeding the in-flight 12-vs-6 floor A/B), and chunk-split dilution where the gold DOCUMENT out-covers the winner but its best chunk loses (41.7% of ERB misses; ~half of muloc duels) — a mechanism the current ladder does not touch. In the near band, RRF lane placement, not coverage, decides (gold frequently out-covers and still loses), which validates the killed coverage tie-break and means the surviving levers must add new independent lanes — phrase, fielded identity (incl. speaker), KV values — rather than re-weight existing evidence.
agents.not_covered_by_ladder: Seven gaps. (1) Chunk-split dilution / doc-level lane aggregation before RRF seating — the largest uncovered mechanism (erb 65/156 duel-flips, muloc 196/372 union-ties-or-beats); no ladder leg groups chunk evidence per source doc, yet the erb taxonomy calls it the highest-leverage single fix and it converges with cc-exchange 0017. (2) Delivery-time near-duplicate suppression — 22% of muloc seats are repeats (dup ingest paths, i18n copies) and enron copy-shadowing is 16+16 misses; nothing on the ladder dedups. (3) The zero-anchor paraphrase core (locomo cognitive: 335 cov0 needles, 99% class miss rate, winners anti-correlated with gold) — the LSA plateau checkpoint acknowledges the wall but is not a lever; the only candidate (condition-gated dense on cov~0 queries) is a new proposal that must be distinguished from, and receipted separately from, the killed default-ON dense. (4) Query-side boilerplate/template stripping at Stage-1 extract — the root fix for muloc's 140 template-echo misses and financebench's formula-boilerplate flooding; the ladder's legs all act on the index side, none on the query side. (5) The length/shape subsidy — no leg addresses it, and since its direction FLIPS between bed families (long wins on erb/finbench/enron, short-dense wins on locomo/obs), it can only be fixed per-lane, never by a global normalization change. (6) Aggregation-shaped queries where meta/process docs beat instance docs (erb other-class 11, financebench wrong_doctype 9) — cross-chunk/cross-doc reasoning has no lever anywhere. (7) Housekeeping with real needle counts: obs abstraction->source linkage (known open), the abstain empty-delivery gate (enron_173_r), CJK extraction (muloc 3), and the grading/union-gold artifacts where the answer text IS delivered under a sibling gene_id or a non-gold obs (enron copies, conv-44_q049) — those inflate miss counts without being retrieval failures.
agents.contradictions: Nine, ranked by consequence. (1) Length direction flips between bed families: erb/finbench/enron winners are LONGER than gold (85% of erb winner seats at the 4000-char cap), locomo/obs winners are SHORTER (obs 134 chars, 2x density) — any single length-normalization tweak is a cross-bed trade, so treat 'length' claims as bed-scoped. (2) Hub concentration flips: muloc (34% of slots held by 96 repeat genes) and locomo (20 docs take 18% of rank-1s) are hubby; erb947k (1645 unique winners/1674 seats) and enron_padded (max 2 questions per gene) are diffuse — hub-targeted levers are bed-local, and the W2.1 kill's 'mass->hubs' mechanism literally has no substrate on erb. (3) Coverage duels flip by bucket: pool-absent winners out-cover gold everywhere, but near-band winners LOSE the coverage duel on four beds (enron_v2 39/72, locomo 259/311, obs 145v47, erb 14/20) — headline 'coverage outgun' framings are bucket-specific, and this is direct confirmation the W2.2 coverage tie-break kill was mechanistically correct. (4) muloc's seat trim cannot be reproduced from the fused-score 15% check (0/135 trimmed slices) — contradicting the assumption that the floor gate operates on fused scores; it fires on tier-level scores, which changes where the tier_hard_floor_frac ladder leg must be implemented. Also muloc's receipt claimed 25 starved rows vs 27 found (7 are rank-drift rows — within jitter, but say 20 clean when precision matters). (5) enron_padded's brief predicted 32 one-way new misses; truth is 48 new + 16 RECOVERED (net 32) — padding is bidirectional rank churn with a negative mean, not one-way suppression. (6) Padding takes ZERO of 1122 seats yet costs 6.4pp — seat-share/winner-identity analyses structurally cannot see pool-tier damage; any future 'distractor' study must instrument the candidate fetch, not just delivered slates. (7) EnronQA native's feared generic-boilerplate spam category is EMPTY ('essentially never wins') while boilerplate is muloc's #1 winner (37%) — boilerplate wins only when the query itself embeds the boilerplate (filled templates), not as a universal spam problem. (8) locomo_obs enrichment is simultaneously the biggest shipped win (+8.4pp delivered) and the dominant residual-miss winner (obs take 94.4% of non-cognitive rank-1s, sometimes shadowing gold from its own session) — 'obs displace rather than bridge' is confirmed, and some displacing obs literally contain the answer, so part of the residual is union-gold labeling, not retrieval. (9) Minor ledger drift: crossbed_stats anatomy says muloc trim=23 vs taxonomy 27 (drift rows; locomo 121, obs 79, enron 10/8, erb 6 all reconcile), and enron trim counts include one abstain row (0 seats, gold rank 2) that is a gate loss, not a cap loss — keep it flagged separately in the floor A/B accounting.
